method: dist/ served by nginx (Range-capable) on 127.0.0.1:8088; Chromium headless 1280x800; CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions latency=50ms download=25Mbps upload=25Mbps; cold cache (Network.clearBrowserCache) per run; time-to-first-usable = navigation start -> map 'load' + buildings source loaded + buildings rendered.
range_request_rationale: The two vector layers are PMTiles archives (buildings 33 MB, trees 77 MB). The browser fetches only the header/directory plus the viewport's z10-z13 tiles via HTTP Range requests: 434 KB of the buildings archive and 16 KB (header only, layer hidden) of the trees archive at first paint - 2.8% of the bundle. The on-disk bundle exceeds the OR-005 50 MiB git-governance threshold by design; SC-008 is a time budget and passes.
minzoom_fix_note: Measured with --minimum-zoom 10 PMTiles (T053 gap fix): MapLibre GL 5.7.1 does not request tiles below a vector source's minzoom, so the previous z12 minimum left the FR-002 initial fitBounds view (z10.9) without buildings. Regenerated buildings.pmtiles and trees.pmtiles at minzoom 10; 12573 buildings render at first paint.
